_readme: Ranking pages the sync should read. Add an entry here and the next run picks
it up — no code change needed.
id       short name, shown in logs and the health block
site     which parser to use. Only 'goff' exists today; a different site
needs a parser in scrape-rankings.js, not just an entry here.
gender   'mens' or 'womens' — restricts matching to that side of the
programs collection, which rules out a whole class of wrong hits
league   written onto matched programs' rankings for context
discover substring matched against links on the Goff rankings index. The
newest matching article wins, so week-numbered URLs never go
url      pin one exact article instead of discovering it. Use this when a
page does not appear on the index.
enabled  set false to park a source without deleting it
_notScraped: written as prose — 'rings in at No. 2' — with no list or table in the page,
rendered or otherwise. There is nothing to parse, so they stay a manual read.
Goff's boys-school-team-rankings articles are high school and out of scope.
